notes: Level 3 Bard (College of Lore). Cutting Words reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration die (d6) to subtract from an enemy’s attack roll, ability check, or damage roll after the roll but before outcome. Spellcasting upgrade: 1st×4 and 2nd×2 slots. Bardic Inspiration 3/day and Song of Rest (d6) remain core resources. Brood must be fed ore.
